t.zh: 一只青蛙要过河。河里一排石头，岸边算第 0 块。每块石头上写着「↶ k」：青蛙只能从往回数第 k 块石头跳到这里。
t.en: A frog wants to cross a river. There is a row of stones, and the bank counts as stone 0. Each stone says “↶ k”: the frog can only jump onto it from the stone k back.

t.zh: 往回数的那块可能很远，5×5 的视野装不下。这一代的机器人「长臂」有一条<wiki-ref to="arms"></wiki-ref>：站在每块石头上，它会伸到往回数第 k 块。伸缩臂够到的那一格在视野下面，点它，视野元件上就多一个输出口。
t.en: The stone k back can be far away, out of a 5×5 view. This era’s robot, Longarm, has a <wiki-ref to="arms"></wiki-ref>: on each stone it reaches the stone k back. What the arm reaches sits under the view; click it and the View part gets an output for it.

goal.zh: 算出青蛙跳到最后一块石头，一共要跳几次。
goal.en: Work out how many jumps the frog needs to reach the last stone.

how.zh: 从岸边往前，一块一块算。岸边还没跳，是 0 次。
how.en: Work forward from the bank, stone by stone. On the bank the frog hasn’t jumped yet: 0 jumps.

say.zh: 青蛙是从往回数第 k 块跳来的，那块要用伸缩臂去读。
say.en: The frog jumps from the stone k back, and that stone is read with the arm.

hints.zh: 跳到这块之前，青蛙在伸缩臂够到的那块上：那里的次数 + 1。
hints.en: Before this jump the frog was on the stone the arm reaches: its count + 1.

hints.zh: 岸边还没跳：放行闸放过一个 0。
hints.en: On the bank there are no jumps yet: let a 0 through a Pass gate.

body.zh: 视野只看身边。伸缩臂让一格读到任意远的一格，远到多少，由这一格自己写的数决定。
body.en: The view only sees what is nearby. The arm lets a cell read a cell however far away, and how far is decided by the number written on the cell itself.
